general.title: General Settings
general.subtitle: Manage your profile, visual appearance, language, and regional preferences.
general.profileDesc: Update your personal photo, display name, and public biography.
general.appearanceDesc: Personalize visual palette, dark mode contrast, and interface density.
general.compactModeDesc: Use condensed paddings and smaller typography.
general.reducedMotionDesc: Minimize spring animations and transition effects.
general.regionalDesc: Configure default interface language, timezone, and calendar formats.

workspace.title: Workspace Preferences
workspace.subtitle: Configure workspace defaults, project behaviors, timeline ergonomics, and editor options.
workspace.detailsDesc: General identification for your collaborative video workspace.
workspace.slugHint: Shareable custom direct link to your workspace.
workspace.defaultsDesc: Default resolutions and layout presets applied to newly created projects.
workspace.autoPlayHoverDesc: Automatically preview video segment when cursor hovers over waveform timeline.

ai.title: AI & Processing Settings
ai.subtitle: Configure foundational AI models, pipeline computing priorities, automations, and audio cleansers.
ai.modelsDesc: Select specialized neural networks for transcription, translation, and speech synthesis.
ai.computeDesc: Adjust hardware acceleration, queuing priority, and batch concurrency.
ai.concurrencyDesc: Maximum simultaneous video chunks processed in parallel.
ai.gpuAccelDesc: Use serverless NVIDIA H100/A100 clusters for 4x faster rendering.
ai.automationDesc: Automatically trigger downstream translation steps immediately upon video upload.
ai.autoTranslationDesc: Automatically transcribe and translate new video uploads into default target language.
ai.autoSummaryDesc: Generate executive TL;DR summary and takeaways for each processed video.
ai.autoChapterDesc: Automatically timestamp video topics and create timeline chapter markers.
ai.speakerDiarizationDesc: Distinguish between multiple speakers and assign distinct voice tracks.
ai.audioEnhanceDesc: Pre-process raw audio to eliminate hums, echo, and stutters before dubbing.
ai.noiseReductionDesc: Isolate speaker voice from air conditioning hum, room reverb, and street traffic.
ai.normalizationDesc: Standardize dynamic audio range to broadcast standard (-14 LUFS).
ai.vocalIsolationDesc: Preserve original background score while replacing vocal track.
ai.fillerWordDesc: Automatically trim vocal pauses, 'um', 'uh', and repeated phrases.

translationVoice.title: Translation & Voice Settings
translationVoice.subtitle: Fine-tune translation localization tone, synthetic voice dubbing models, and closed-caption subtitle typography.
translationVoice.translationDesc: Set default source and target language pairs with contextual tone presets.
translationVoice.glossaryDesc: Preserve exact brand names, acronyms, and product terminology during translation.
translationVoice.timestampSyncDesc: Constrain translated sentences to fit original speaker utterance duration.
translationVoice.voiceDesc: Choose default voice actor, modulate pitch & speed, and configure dubbing emotions.
translationVoice.subtitleDesc: Configure burned-in and downloadable closed captions with live styling visualizer.

billing.title: Billing & Subscription
billing.subtitle: Manage active tier subscription, monitor real-time pipeline quotas, invoices, and payment cards.
billing.planDesc: Your workspace is currently on the high-performance VidNova Pro tier.
billing.usageDesc: Live tracking of video minutes, neural translation words, and cloud storage.
billing.paymentDesc: Credit cards and billing instruments on file for automated renewals.
billing.invoicesDesc: View and download receipts for past subscription charges.

notifications.title: Notification Preferences
notifications.subtitle: Choose what triggers alerts, delivery channels (Email/Push), and batch digest frequencies.
notifications.pipelineDesc: Real-time notifications during transcription, translation, and synthetic dubbing.
notifications.processingUpdatesDesc: Notify immediately when video translation and alignment render completes.
notifications.exportReadyDesc: Send direct download link once final 1080p/4K master file is rendered.
notifications.failedProcessingDesc: Immediate priority alert if an audio track or video codec encounters an error.
notifications.securityDesc: High-priority notifications for login sessions, credentials, and billing events.
notifications.securityAlertsDesc: Receive alerts when new devices sign in or password changes occur.
notifications.emailNotificationsDesc: Receive critical summaries and invoices at alex.morgan@vidnova.ai
notifications.tipsNewsDesc: Learn about newly added voice models, workflow tutorials, and releases.
notifications.channelsDesc: Manage push notification permissions and batch digest delivery intervals.
notifications.inAppPushDesc: Display pop-up banners while working inside the video editor.
notifications.browserPushDesc: Show desktop OS push alerts even when the browser tab is minimized.

integrations.title: Integrations & Developer API
integrations.subtitle: Connect external cloud storage, third-party neural voice engines, communication channels, and developer tokens.
integrations.storageDesc: Auto-import source footage and export dubbed video outputs to your cloud storage.
integrations.aiProvidersDesc: Bring your own API keys for custom ElevenLabs voice clones and OpenAI endpoints.
integrations.productivityDesc: Send team alerts and trigger downstream automations via Slack & Discord.
integrations.apiKeysDesc: Programmatically translate videos and query job transcripts via VidNova REST API.

security.title: Security & Authentication
security.subtitle: Manage account passwords, multi-factor authentication, active login sessions, and audit events.
security.passwordDesc: Update your account password. Use at least 8 characters with numbers and symbols.
security.twoFactorDesc: Protect your video workspace by requiring a time-based TOTP code upon login.
security.sessionsDesc: Devices currently logged into your VidNova account.
security.auditDesc: Recent sensitive security events and authentication attempts.

privacy.title: Data & Privacy Controls
privacy.subtitle: Manage stored project assets, telemetry preferences, data export archives, retention schedules, and account deletion.
privacy.summaryDesc: Overview of video assets, neural dubbings, and synchronized transcripts stored.
privacy.exportDesc: Download an offline copy of your projects, transcriptions, glossaries, and invoices in standard JSON/ZIP.
privacy.aiPrivacyDesc: Control whether your audio recordings and transcriptions are used for AI training.
privacy.aiTrainingDesc: Strictly prohibit VidNova or sub-processors from training foundation models on your content.
privacy.telemetryDesc: Share anonymous app crash reports and latency metrics to help improve video translation speed.
privacy.personalizedDesc: Allow AI assistant to tailor voice and subtitle style suggestions based on editing habits.
privacy.retentionDesc: Automate cleanup schedules for discarded projects, trash, and temporary audio waveforms.
privacy.autoCleanCacheDesc: Automatically flush temporary audio chunk files older than 7 days (saves ~8.0 GB).
